en: Black‑and‑white vintage photograph showing a very large crowd gathered outdoors in a park or tree‑lined avenue. Most people wear hats and coats typical of the early 20th century. In the background there is a small monument or statue on a pedestal and some placards held above the crowd, but no legible writing. The card has the typical white border and format of an old photographic postcard.
